page.overview:
Who is Jakob Ornstine?

Jakob Ornstine was a hunter that Geralt met on the edge of Caed Dhu in Angren.

When he was 10 years old, he first met Marta on account of her walking through town to sell her mother's baked goods. At the time, Jakob would follow her about as he was wanting the pastries she was selling, Over time though, as the two grew up, he became infatuated with her, but she had no feelings for him. Instead of accepting this, Jakob instead got her father to sell her into marriage to him for 21 silver coins and seven fox skins.

Their marriage from the start was abusive, with Jakob forcing himself on her and beating her regularly, all while saying it was love. He also didn't appear to accept the reality, and instead invented an idealized relationship in his head, where they were happy and led a wonderful life together, a far cry from reality. Then one day, after he crushed a few of Marta's prized seashells she'd collected, he sent her to the blacksmith, Talton, to create a new dagger with an inlaid hilt.

Jakob began to get suspicious when Marta was frequently checking on the dagger's progress and, about three weeks after putting in the request, he caught Talton and Marta having a rendezvous on the beach. Angry over this, he killed Talton, but Jakob started to believe that instead of him killing another person, he had instead saved his wife from a horrible sea monster that almost dragged her into the sea and the marks on her body were from the vicious ordeal rather than love marks Talton had left behind on Marta. He also began to believe Marta was a bruxa and drained him of his manhood and some time later, he killed her, but not before she cursed his very existence.
